'''Ben Gaddink''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who lived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the early days of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Gaddink ran an apothecary in the planet's capital city of [[Bestine (city)/Legends|Bestine]].<ref name="Kenobi" />
